summary: Make large Dropbox MCP lists complete: read-only list tools with a page-size input get a conservative default page size when the caller sets none, so Dropbox's own cursor resumes with nothing omitted, and oversized POST list pages are bounded as entries plus identity summaries of every omitted entry instead of a 4,000-byte string preview. When summaries cannot fit, the upstream cursor is renamed to cursor_after_page and the note states how to re-request the page with retry_page_size.
reason: Every Dropbox list endpoint is an RPC POST with an empty MCP page config, so endpointResponse only had a list path for GET and pages above 60,000 bytes became non-resumable previews. Dropbox's default page sizes (up to 2,000 entries) routinely exceed the budget, and keeping the upstream cursor on a cut page would skip the omitted entries.
validated_outcome: TestMCPListFolderInjectsDefaultPageSize, TestMCPLargeListFolderResumesWithNothingSkipped, TestEndpointResponseBoundsPOSTCursorListAsEntries, TestEndpointResponseSummarizesNestedSearchMatches, and TestEndpointResponseRenamesCursorWhenEntriesCannotBeSummarized fail on the generated tools.go and bound.go and pass with the patch. If a reprint emits POST-aware page defaults and list bounding in the generator, drop this patch.
